name: Notification Status 3 Code
definition: Specifies the status of the notification in a coded form.

RCBD.name: Received But Different
RCBD.definition: Event(s) as described in the notification to receive occurred but details are different.

RCVD.name: Received
RCVD.definition: Event(s) as described in the notification to receive occurred.

NRCD.name: Not Received
NRCD.definition: Event(s) as described in the notification to receive did not occur.
